subject: PRAC
title: Advocacy
description: Critical analysis of oral advocacy skills, including a range of settings and appellate advocacy.

prerequisites.text: Completed PRAC 147D1/D2 Intro Legal Research OR equivalent (transfer & advance standing students only).

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have completed PRAC 155D1/D2. Limited to 2nd year Law students only.

subject: PRAC
title: Advanced Mooting 1
description: Participation, under Faculty supervision, as a Faculty representative, in an advanced mooting competition approved for this purpose by the Dean. Students may register for Advanced Mooting a maximum of twice.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken PRAC 188.

notes: Note: Advanced Mooting includes mooting competitions such as the Jessup International Moot, Concours Charles-Rousseau, Gale Cup Moot, Tribunal École Pierre-Basile Mignault, etc.
